rationale: Left adds a parameter to `send` and updates the call site it knows about. Right adds a new call site using the old one-argument form. Merged, the new call does not type-check. Name-based reference checking cannot catch this because `send` is still defined -- it needs arity or signature awareness. Both Lattice and Mergiraf are expected to be WRONG here; the scenario is included so the suite records a shared blind spot rather than only our strengths.
